claims.span_literal: mNK cells comprised a distinct cluster marked by expression of FCGR3A, FGFBP2, KLRF1 and EOMES
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, mature natural killer cells are marked by expression of FCGR3A, FGFBP2, KLRF1, and EOMES.

claims.span_literal: one cluster of NK-like cells discerned by expression of IL7R, SELL and CD2 similar to previously described CD56^(bright) immature NK (iNK) cells in human peripheral tissues18
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, immature natural killer cells are discerned by expression of IL7R, SELL, and CD2.

claims.span_literal: a population of NK-like cells distinguished by expression of CXCR6, KLRC1 and GZMK consistent with tissue-resident NK (trNK) cells described in the human liver
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, tissue-resident natural killer cells are distinguished by expression of CXCR6, KLRC1, and GZMK.

claims.span_literal: Four clusters did not express the NK cell-lineage-associated genes IRF8, EOMES, KLRF1, NCAM1 or PRF1.
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, innate lymphoid cells do not express the natural killer cell-lineage-associated genes IRF8, EOMES, KLRF1, NCAM1, or PRF1.

claims.span_literal: these clusters could be distinguished from NK-lineage cells based on CD200R1 and IL7R coexpression
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, innate lymphoid cells are distinguished from natural killer-lineage cells based on CD200R1 and IL7R coexpression.

claims.span_literal: GATA3 and IL1RL1 consistent with ILC2s described in mice and humans
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, type 2 innate lymphoid cells are defined by expression of GATA3 and IL1RL1.

claims.span_literal: ZNF683 and TBX21 consistent with ILC1s described in mice
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, type 1 innate lymphoid cells are defined by expression of ZNF683 and TBX21.

claims.span_literal: CCR6, IL1R1 and IL23R consistent with ILC3s described in mice and humans
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, type 3 innate lymphoid cells are defined by expression of CCR6, IL1R1, and IL23R.

claims.span_literal: SELL and IL1R1 consistent with circulating ILC precursor cells (ILCPs) found in human blood
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, innate lymphoid cell precursor cells are defined by expression of SELL and IL1R1.

claims.span_literal: Our CD45+-sorted scRNA-seq dataset suggested that CD200R1 expression could distinguish ILCs from mNK cells, similar to previous studies performed in mice and human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs)
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, CD200R1 expression distinguishes innate lymphoid cells from mature natural killer cells.

claims.span_literal: ncMos based on expression of FCGR3A and HES4
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, nonclassical monocytes are defined by expression of FCGR3A and HES4.

claims.span_literal: Mo-1s by expression of FCER1A
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, classical monocyte state 1 cells are defined by expression of FCER1A.

claims.span_literal: Mo-2s via increased expression of CSF3R, FCAR and SELL, compared with Mo-1s
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, classical monocyte state 2 cells are defined by increased expression of CSF3R, FCAR, and SELL compared with classical monocyte state 1 cells.

claims.span_literal: a population of human WAT neutrophils based on expression of THBS1 and S100A12
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, neutrophils are defined by expression of THBS1 and S100A12.

claims.span_literal: TREM2, CD9 and LPL expressing lipid-associated macrophages (LAMs)8
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, lipid-associated macrophages are defined by expression of TREM2, CD9, and LPL.

claims.span_literal: LYVE1, SELENOP and C1Q, expressing PVMs32
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, perivascular macrophages are defined by expression of LYVE1, SELENOP, and C1Q.

claims.span_literal: an uncharacterized inflammatory macrophage (IM) population with high expression of CCL3L1, TNF and CXCL3
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, inflammatory macrophages are defined by high expression of CCL3L1, TNF, and CXCL3.

claims.span_literal: conventional type 1 DCs (cDC1s) defined by expression of IRF8, DPP4, CADM1 and XCR1
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, conventional type 1 dendritic cells are defined by expression of IRF8, DPP4, CADM1, and XCR1.

claims.span_literal: coventional type 2 DCs subset A (cDC2As), via expression of CD1C, IRF4, IL7R and LAMP3
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset A is defined by expression of CD1C, IRF4, IL7R, and LAMP3.

terms.normalized_label: conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset A

claims.span_literal: conventional type 2 DCs subset B (cDC2Bs) by increased expression of CD1C, IRF4, FCER1A and CLEC10A
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset B is defined by increased expression of CD1C, IRF4, FCER1A, and CLEC10A.

terms.normalized_label: conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset B

claims.span_literal: mature CD200R1+ ILC populations did not express PERFORIN or EOMES
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, mature innate lymphoid cells do not express PRF1 (perforin) or EOMES.

claims.span_literal: cDC2Bs (CD26^(-)CD1C+CD206+CD14^(hi)FCER1A+CLEC10A+)
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset B is characterized by CD1C, MRC1 (CD206), FCER1A, and CLEC10A expression, and lack of DPP4 (CD26) expression.

terms.normalized_label: conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset B

claims.span_literal: cDC2As (CD26^(-)CD1C+CD206-CD14^(int)FCER1A^(-)CLEC10A^(-))
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset A is characterized by CD1C expression and lack of DPP4 (CD26), MRC1 (CD206), FCER1A, and CLEC10A expression.

terms.normalized_label: conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset A

claims.span_literal: WAT cDC1s were distinguished by expression of DPP4 (CD26) CD26+CD1C^(-)
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens white adipose tissue, conventional type 1 dendritic cells are distinguished by expression of DPP4 (CD26) and lack of CD1C expression.
